description: Rewrite tone presets (doc/design.md section 6.3.1): the chips under Rewrite's field, the clip style card's Tone menu (section 6.6) and the clip planner's tone (doc/spec/ai.md section 16). `instruction` is the exact text Rewrite sends and the planner applies. `choices` are the card's two non-tone entries. A user's saved tone (settings `rewrite.myTones`) has an id starting with "my-". Generated by tools/fixtures/voice-lab/generate_rewrite_tones.py; do not edit by hand.

tones.title: Viral YouTuber
tones.instruction: Rewrite it the way a top YouTuber would say it. Put a hook in the first sentence that makes a stranger stop scrolling, by rewording my opening rather than adding a line before it. Then short, punchy sentences, one thought each. Where attention would dip, make a pattern interrupt by turning a line into a sharp question or a quick turn. Build to one clear payoff and land it. Energetic but natural, like me on my best take, never hype for its own sake. Make it tighter by cutting rather than adding: each rewritten phrase is as long as the words it replaces or shorter, never longer, because the video keeps running under it. Never pad with filler words or connectors. Keep my facts, names, numbers and meaning, and keep my voice. Every line must be speakable as is: no emoji, hashtags, links or stage directions.

tones.title: Punchy Reel
tones.instruction: Make it a fast Reel that runs under 30 seconds. Start on the most surprising line, cut every word that does not earn its place, and keep one idea per sentence. Short, rhythmic lines that build to a quick, memorable ending. Make it tighter by cutting rather than adding: each rewritten phrase is as long as the words it replaces or shorter, never longer, because the video keeps running under it. Never pad with filler words or connectors. Keep my facts, names, numbers and meaning, and keep my voice. Every line must be speakable as is: no emoji, hashtags, links or stage directions.

tones.title: Storyteller
tones.instruction: Tell it as a story. A quick setup that puts the listener in the moment, then the problem or tension, then the turn and the payoff. Use the concrete details I already gave, in plain spoken words. Warm and vivid, never dramatic for its own sake. Each rewritten phrase must take no longer to say than the words it replaces, because the video keeps running under it. Shorter is fine; never pad with filler words or connectors.
